_doc: Alarm thresholds (monitoring plan 阶段3). Operator-tunable knobs — change a threshold here,
re-run scripts/apply-alarms.sh, NO code change. Each alarm reads a CloudWatch metric created
by a metric-filter (a-class-metrics.json or alarm-metrics.json) and notifies the SNS topic.
TWO alarm semantics (plan 阶段3, never mix on one alarm):
- SPARSE 'appears == anomaly': metric only has points when the event fires; alarm on >=1 in a
window with treatMissingData=notBreaching (missing = fine, a point = page). Used for the
dense-but-rare health counters where ANY occurrence is worth a look.
- DENSE rate: metric is dense (defaultValue:0), alarm on a rate/count over threshold;
treatMissingData is near-moot but set to notBreaching.
- LIVENESS backstop: a dense, always-emitting metric (QuestionsReceived) with
treatMissingData=breaching → if the log pipeline dies (CloudWatch agent down / gateway
silent), the metric goes missing and the alarm fires, instead of every health alarm
silently sitting quiet. MUST point at a stable dense metric, not a sparse one (else it
sits in INSUFFICIENT_DATA forever). See plan 阶段3 验收点.
metricName must match a metric emitted by an applied filter. statistic Sum for counts.

alarms.name: ToolcallLeakDetected
alarms.alarmDescription: 竞泄复发：agent 原始 <invoke> XML 泄漏到用户卡片。出现即异常（dense metric, >=1/5min 即告警）。查 num_turns/cache_read 冷启动竞速。

alarms.name: FinalizeFailed
alarms.alarmDescription: 冻卡：finalize 失败，卡片停在“分析中”不收尾。出现即异常（dense metric, >=1/5min 即告警）。

alarms.name: AnswerFailedBurst
alarms.comment: NOTE: AnswerFailed is dimensioned (by reason) → SPARSE, can't alarm stably. This burst alarm watches the DENSE AnswerCompleted as a proxy floor is wrong; instead we alarm on the dense failure proxy only once a dedicated dense AnswerFailedTotal filter exists. Until then this entry is DISABLED (enabled:false) so apply-alarms skips it — documented gap, not a silent miss.

alarms.name: LogPipelineStalled
alarms._liveness: LOG-PIPELINE LIVENESS BACKSTOP (plan 阶段3). Watches GatewayHeartbeat — the gateway emits gateway_heartbeat every 60s REGARDLESS of traffic, so this metric is NONZERO in normal operation even on an idle night. Semantics: alive → Sum>=1 every 5min window → OK; pipeline dead (CloudWatch agent down / gateway crashed / silent) → metric goes MISSING → treatMissingData=breaching fires after 3 missing windows (~15min). CRITICAL: this MUST watch the heartbeat, NOT a traffic-driven metric like QuestionsReceived — a traffic metric reads 0/absent on a legitimately quiet night, which is indistinguishable from a dead pipeline and would false-page (cross-review HIGH). The >=1-with-breaching design means the alarm only fires on MISSING data, never on a low-but-present heartbeat.
alarms.alarmDescription: 日志管道存活兜底：网关心跳（每 60s 一次，与流量无关）连续 ~15 分钟缺失 → CloudWatch agent 挂了 / 网关崩了 / 日志停流。健康类告警全靠日志管道，管道一断会静默漏报，故此兜底。空闲夜晚心跳照发，不会误报。
